sources.title: Operazione c.d. EUREKA
sources.publisher: Procura della Repubblica – DDA Reggio Calabria

sources.title: Over 1 000 years’ imprisonment for mafia members following largest ever action against Italian organised crime
sources.claim: Eurojust confirms the first shortened-procedure judgment concerning 76 defendants and describes participation in an international drug-trafficking organization, without naming individual defendants or their precise conviction counts.
